summary: Added /goal_workers support in Telegram goal commands: command menu spec, parseGoalWorkersArg(codex/claude_code/both/all), usage/current-value messaging, config-write persistence (loadConfig/writeConfigFile), and in-memory cfg updates via authAndResolve/sendGoalReply flow. Added tests in src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts covering no-arg default display, codex set, claude_code set, both set, invalid arg handling, and config-writes-disabled handling. Verification run: pnpm vitest run src/telegram/goal-commands.test.ts -t "registerTelegramGoalCommands /goal_workers" (pass), pnpm build (pass), pnpm lint (pass).
